BAD INFLUENCE v4 — ACTUAL GODICE BLUETOOTH BRIDGE REUSED FROM ARCADIUM 10,000

START: Run START_BAD_INFLUENCE.bat on Windows (Python must be installed) and open http://localhost:8080 in Chrome/Edge. Bluetooth requires secure context (localhost or HTTPS), not file://.

PAIR: In side panel, PAIR each of the twelve slots (JAX L/R through ZOE L/R). Web Bluetooth prompts separately per die. Roll dice to send live values to player cards and Mini Vibe dialog. Use simulated/manual dice if hardware is unavailable.

GoDice SDK, shared utilities, simulator and GoDiceManager are copied directly from the user's prior working arcadium-10000.html source. Physical Bluetooth pairing is not tested in this environment. The game engine is the v3 scoring prototype and remote Mini Vibe networking is NOT yet integrated. Pair/disconnect control included.
